title: Accounting for Bonds with Stock Warrants

items.concept: Proportional allocation of detachable bond-with-warrants proceeds; subsequent straight-line premium amortization schedule; period-end interest adjusting JE; warrant exercise and expiration; bond maturity

Number-variant twin: incremental allocation when only warrant FV is known; subsequent straight-line discount amortization schedule; period-end interest adjusting JE; exercise of all warrants; bond maturity

Period-end adjusting JE emphasis — partial-period interest accrual and discount amortization when bonds with detachable warrants are issued off fiscal year-end; full interest-date payment; warrant exercise; maturity settlement
Classification of allocation method for detachable warrants; accounting contrast for nondetachable warrants
